name: makersmcp
description: MakersMCP: free kits for makers in one MCP. Brand kits, fonts, screenshots, demo videos, launch films, fitted music, a video in each place's shape and burned captions from a website or a file, made on your own machine.

plugins.name: makersmcp
plugins.description: One MCP server for the MakersMCP kits: easybrandkit, easyfontkit, easyscreenshotkit, launch-film, musicfit, reframekit and easycaptionkit. Each tool saves its files in a folder and tells your agent what is in it.
